statement.zh: 伊辛（Išān Baḥrīyāt）慕尼黑队 1973–1974 年结果（已刊建筑与出土）见 Hrouda（编）《伊辛》I（1977）。
statement.en: At Isin (Išān Baḥrīyāt), the 1973–1974 Munich expedition results (architecture and finds as published) are documented in Hrouda (ed.) Isin–Išān Baḥrīyāt I (1977).
